cat > '/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u036/system/state/workspace/programs/task-83e7fd37.py' <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter, deque
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r,c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r,c)])
            seen.add((r,c))
            comp=[]
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and (ny,nx) not in seen and g[ny][nx]==color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in comp); r1=max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0=min(x for y,x in comp); c1=max(x for y,x in comp)
            # A square one-cell outline surrounding a blank interior.
            if r1-r0 != c1-c0 or r1-r0 < 2:
                continue
            border={(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                    if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(comp) != border:
                continue
            inner = [(y,x) for y in range(r0+1,r1) for x in range(c0+1,c1)]
            if not inner or any(g[y][x] != bg for y,x in inner):
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0-1) % 2 == 1 else 2
            for y,x in inner:
                g[y][x]=fill
    return g
PY

    return out
